description: Curated worldwide operator / marine-park dive maps. Goal: every shop Google My Map, every marine-park mooring GPS file, every resort site list we can legally fetch. Prefer official park KML/GPX, then public Google My Maps (mid + forcekml), then GeoJSON endpoints. OpenDiveMap + PADI remain separate bulk adapters.
strategy: 2. Official marine-park / sanctuary mooring GPS (this registry, kind=marine_park)
3. Public Google My Maps from operators (format=google_my_maps, mid=...)
4. Discover more: OSM operators.website → find embedded maps (future crawler)
5. Never scrape closed travel portals without license; prefer open/public map exports
